evidence_leads.intent: Lost workdays turn heat exposure into household income pressure.
evidence_leads.boundary: Do not extrapolate surveyed percentage losses to all Dhaka households.

evidence_leads.intent: At national scale, accumulated lost work becomes a macroeconomic constraint.
evidence_leads.boundary: National workday-loss estimates are modeled/estimated and must be labelled accordingly.

evidence_leads.intent: Some factory cooling investments can repay through reduced heat-related losses.
evidence_leads.boundary: Payback estimates are study-specific economic estimates, not guaranteed returns.

evidence_leads.intent: Adaptation is also a distribution question: who can afford protection and who bears the residual heat.
evidence_leads.boundary: Frame as evidenced inequality/exposure and policy question; do not assign motives or predict policy outcomes.
